## Owner task or defect

Describe the task and link the issue.

## Change

State what changed and what remains outside scope.

## Evidence

List checks run and their results. For content, include exact source sections and limits. Add redacted desktop/phone screenshots where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Desktop changes were checked with `npm run test:desktop`.
- [ ] Storage and backup compatibility were checked.
- [ ] Source records and clinical limits match the change.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are current.
- [ ] No private records, tokens or raw third-party captures are included.
